Civil War salted paper maps. AL-49.
Contributors: Michler, N. (Nathaniel), 1827-1881; Weyss, J. E.
Library of Congress. Civil War maps (2nd ed.), 408

Relief shown by hachures. Shows railroads in red, rivers in blue. Indicates what appears to be a fort with artillery, vegetation, roads, houses and names of residents. Sun print.
